# Ramenhead
> Authentic Japanese Ramen in Cape Town

Ramenhead is a premium ramen restaurant specializing in freshly made noodles and 18-hour simmered broths.

## Locations
- **Speaker's Corner**: 37 Parliament St, Cape Town.
- **Time Out Market**: V&A Waterfront, Cape Town.

## Details
- **Cuisine**: Japanese, Ramen.
- **Hours**: Tuesday-Sunday, 5 PM - 10 PM.
- **Contact**: +27673128061 | info@ramenhead.co.za
- **Booking**: via Dineplan (https://www.dineplan.com/restaurants/ramenhead).
